scope: Independent read-only review of shared_gap_ivp.py, shared_access_gap.py, refine_shared_gap.py, refine_shared_access_gap.py; no source or baseline changes

checks_passed.training_observation_loading: Only declared train IDs are loaded by JointProblem; observed means/counts and floor/compliance masks are correctly computed record-by-record.
checks_passed.shared_material_structure: Access adds only one scalar B, no topology or cycle input; original drive/derivative inherited unchanged; B=0 reduction and signed/passive inverse covered by tests.
checks_passed.circuit_and_state: Positive invariant is derived from original drive/current cap and remains valid for AccessGapLaw; turning/polarity boundaries and SET-to-RESET propagation are explicit.

findings.issue: Optimizer xtol termination is not evidence of a stationary optimum, and local finite-difference Jacobian is step-size sensitive.
findings.action: Do not describe this fit as a converged local optimum or infer parameter identifiability from its single recorded Jacobian. Final parameter selection needs an explicit optimization-status statement; derivative-sensitive SET directions need independent trajectory checks before gradient-based conclusions.

acknowledged_objective_scope.description: Two consecutive 1T model pairs both compare with all-training mean, with equal 1/2 weights. This is a declared shared-waveform surrogate, not exact ordered32-cycle SSE. The module top comment is broader than the implementation.
acknowledged_objective_scope.action: Final evaluator should label fitting as a two-pair surrogate and report ordered full-training error separately. Accurate, block, access and best predeclared access_profile discrepancies are quantified; none reverse the ranking. Block remains only a small improvement.

seed_provenance_note.description: The fixed2.675V initializer equals the rounded median midpoint of the last-below/first-compliance voltage interval among the declared14 training bare SET records. It is not the first-compliance sampled voltage itself.
seed_provenance_note.action: No change to the running fit is needed; preserve provenance as initialization-only evidence.

access_initial_profile.interpretation: Local initialization improvement within Access family, still worse than accurate/block; not optimizer convergence or physical validation.
